newsitem.title: USA: Chromatics says FDA requests information.
newsitem.headline: Chromatics says FDA requests information.

text.p: Chromatics Color Sciences International Inc said on Monday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had requested more information and clarification on its request to market a device for monitoring bilirubin infant jaundice through a child's skin.
The device, known as the Colormate III device, offers an alternative to drawing blood to measure bilirubin and is non-invasive, the company said.
The company added that it believed it would be able to respond to the FDA within the required 30-day period.
Chromatics Color Sciences specializes in scientific color measurement for use in the cosmetic and beauty industries, as well as for potential medical applications.
